newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London edge up in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London edge up in quiet trade.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks in London regained some ground in thin trade on Monday after their fifth consecutive losing session in Hong Kong overnight, traders said.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index was 11.30 points up from the Hong Kong close at 13,306.20 by 1644 GMT.
"It's been a very, very dull day with hardly any turnover," one trader said.
There was unlikely to be much market activity until Tuesday afternoon, traders said, when U.S. consumer confidence figures are due.
They said banks were the only real performers, with most stocks in the sector up from their Hong Kong close.
The Hang Seng fell 84.65 points, or 0.63 percent, to close at 13,294.90 overnight in Hong Kong.
